internalCircuit.name: 15 Segment Hex Driver Fixed
internalCircuit.description: Simple 7-segment hex driver plus decimal point passthrough. Full 15-segment diagonals are reserved for a later driver.

fixedNotes: Simplified to classic seven-segment outputs A-G plus DOT_2.
Two-letter 15-segment diagonal/crossbar outputs are intentionally omitted for now.
Import the full 15-segment export later when building the ASCII driver/display variant.
